blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO), in coordination with the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), raided an authorized lotto outlet on Wednesday, Nov. 4, after undercover operatives caught the establishment using its government license as a cover to run an illegal numbers racket. Operatives from the PCSO and the NBI Fraud and Financial Crimes Division (NBI-FFCD), led by Chief Palmer U. Mallari, targeted the authorized lotto outlet located along Block 1, Lot 7, Camarin Road, Almar, Caloocan City. The crackdown stemmed from a surveillance and test-buy operation where outlet personnel issued illegitimate tickets and accepted bet payments via GCash rather than […]...
